newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: UOL land buy to raise interest costs.
newsitem.headline: UOL land buy to raise interest costs.

text.p: United Overseas Land Ltd said on Friday its joint purchase of land in a recent tender for Singapore $508 million would raise its interest costs this financial year.
It said in a statement it expected to incur additional interest costs of about S$4.5 million in the financial year ended December 31, 1997.
The purchase by UOL, United Overseas Bank Ltd (UOB) and Singapore Land Ltd, was not expected to have an effect on the net tangible assets of the UOL group.
UOL will be responsible for 60 percent of the deal, with the remaining stake shared equally between UOB and Singapore Land.
The land, for commercial development, has a leasehold tenure of 99 years and an area of 16,669 square metres.
The Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA) issued a tender to sell the land on December 19, and the tender was awarded on April 21.
